parts.visual:
A chain is only as strong as its weakest link. In business, a system can only move as fast as its slowest process. This is the Bottleneck.

The Process:
1. Identify: Find where work is piling up.
2. Exploit: Ensure the bottleneck is operating at 100% capacity.
3. Elevate: Spend money or hire people to expand the bottleneck.
4. Repeat: Once you fix one bottleneck, a new one will appear.
parts.audio: A business system can only move as fast as its slowest process. Executives use the Theory of Constraints to identify and elevate operational bottlenecks.

questions.question: Your sales team can sign 100 clients a day. Your onboarding team can only set up 20 clients a day. Where is the bottleneck?
questions.explanation: The onboarding team is the constraint. Even if sales signs 500 clients, the company will only process 20 a day.

questions.question: Listen to the Operations VP. What mistake are they making?
questions.tts_text: Our onboarding team is overwhelmed, so I'm going to hire five more salespeople to increase our revenue.
questions.explanation: Hiring more salespeople when the onboarding team is already drowning will just create angry clients who pay but never get set up.

questions.question: According to the Theory of Constraints, what happens after you fix the primary bottleneck?
options: A new bottleneck will immediately appear somewhere else in the chain.
questions.correct_answer: A new bottleneck will immediately appear somewhere else in the chain.
questions.explanation: If you fix onboarding, suddenly customer support might become the new bottleneck because they can't handle the influx of new, happy clients.

questions.question: How do you 'Exploit' a bottleneck?
options: Yell at the employees in that department.
Ensure that the bottleneck process never wastes a single second. If an engineer is the bottleneck, don't make them do administrative paperwork.
questions.correct_answer: Ensure that the bottleneck process never wastes a single second. If an engineer is the bottleneck, don't make them do administrative paperwork.
questions.explanation: Before spending money to hire more people, ensure the current constraint is completely shielded from non-essential tasks.
